review.mathCheck: Reciprocation gives b_n=2b_{n-1}-b_{n-2}, so consecutive differences equal 4/3. Hence b_n=(4n-1)/3 and a_2019=3/8075. This positive general formula also verifies that the recurrence remains defined. Since 3 does not divide 8075, p+q=8078, choice E.
